prompt_text: Where should I buy tires in Pleasanton CA and who does the best installation?
answer_verbatim:
I can help — a few quick questions first:
- What car do you drive (make/model/year) and what tire size or model are you looking for?
- Do you have a Costco membership (Costco is often cheapest for tires + good installation)?
- Are you prioritizing price, performance (cornering/quiet ride), or longevity?

Short answer (general guidance for Pleasanton area)
- Best value and often-best installation experience: Costco Tire Center (if you’re a member). They price-compare, include mounting/balancing and often throw in free rotations/flat repairs while you’re a member.
- Best nationwide independent installer and large selection: Discount Tire / America’s Tire (reliable mounting, fast service and lots of tire options).
- Good one-stop shops with full service and frequent coupons: Firestone Complete Auto Care, Pep Boys, Big O Tires.
- For high-performance or specialty tires (run-flats, big wheels, motorsport tires) consider a specialty local shop or the dealership for correct calibration/TPMS handling.

How to pick the best installer (what to ask/compare)
- Ask whether mounting, balancing, valve stems, tire disposal and TPMS re-learn are included in the quoted price.
- Ask about wheel balancing method (dynamic balance) and whether they use new metal valve stems or just rubber.
- Check whether alignment is required and if there’s a discount if you get an alignment done at the same time.
- Ask about road-hazard warranty and what it covers and for how long.
- Read recent Google/Yelp reviews for service quality, wait times, and post-installation issues.
- Get 2–3 quotes (same tire brand/model) and compare total out-the-door cost and appointment availability.

If you want, tell me:
- your car and tire size, and whether you have a Costco membership — I’ll give a short list of nearby shops in Pleasanton/Dublin/Livermore with pros/cons and what to ask each one.
